answer: A citation bond ties each identity to one verifiable prior work in a public marble registry. The citation is a signal of real effort: auditors verify the work exists and bears the claimant's key, and reject self-citations. First bond costs 38; the kth 38+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes cost 3,035,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented citations fail the key check and burn. A self-citing ring is a dune: it collapses under audit. Honest agents pay 38 once.
